messages:
DeployBot: rolling deploy scheduled: release v2026.03.21-mig-42. Migration 'preferences_add' will run on shard groups A,C then D. Start 03:00 UTC. Throttle: 10rps. Rollback enabled. Runbook: /docs/runbooks/migrations#preferences_add :eyes:
Lina: ack. who is on-call for the window? I can cover 02:45-04:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll run a canary on shard B at 02:30, small batch (100 users), then approve. If canary looks flaky we stop and rollback to v2026.03.20-app pin.
Tess: final checklist: 1) canary pass, 2) preflight txn-check, 3) no > 5 lock_waits in 60s. I'll post checklist 15m before.
Pradeep: added a short preflight SQL to validate long-running txns: ```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND now() - state_change > interval '30 seconds';
```
Pradeep: prepared kill script if we see zombie queries. Will share on #eng-oncall right before start.
Lina: what's our escape hatch command for DeployBot if locks spike?
DeployBot: accepted commands: `/deploy abort <id>` to stop active rollout, `/deploy rollback --to-tag <tag>` to revert schema + app pin. Example: `/deploy rollback --to-tag v2026.03.20 --reason "lock spike"`.
MigWatch: alert rule created: lock_waits >= 5 for 1m triggers PagerDuty and posts to #eng-oncall. Also added a secondary alert for row-level lock_avg_time > 200ms.
Sam: plan: canary -> wait 10m -> shard A -> wait 10m -> shard C -> shard D. If any step fails, we abort and rollback.
Tess: release notes draft for release repo: "Add user_preferences column + non-blocking backfill behind feature flag. Canary rollout across shards; escape hatch available. No incompat changes to API." I'll push PR after canary.
Lina: tagging Pradeep and Sam: please pin migrations to the release tag once canary approved. We don't want half of fleet running a newer migration.
Pradeep: noted. pin command in deploy UI is available; I'll pin app image and migration tag simultaneously.
Sam: quick note: we'll set backfill rate to 0.5 rows/sec during shard A to limit IO. config snippet: ```yaml
backfill: rate: 0.5
timeout: 15m
```
Lina: if we need to rollback, remember to flip feature flag off first to avoid app layer errors, then call DeployBot rollback. Sequence: flag off -> rollback migration -> pin app -> monitor.
Tess: ok I'll post the final roll/fail decision tree in #release-war-room 15m pre-window.
Pradeep: I'll be watching pg_stat_activity and replication lag. If lag > 2min we abort.
DeployBot: deploy started for shard B canary (task id: db-mig-71321-canary). Watch progress at /deploys/71321.
Sam: canary progress looks good so far, 40/100 applied, no abnormal locks. :thumbsup:
Lina: received. keep hammering on the kill list ready.
Tess: canary passed. Sam give green for shard A when ready.
Sam: green for shard A. starting staged apply now.
MigWatch: note: minor lock_wait spike at 03:18 UTC on shard A (3 concurrent waits) — below threshold.
Pradeep: observed one long-running analytics job, manually paused it. Continuing.
Lina: all teams acked. Proceeding with remaining shards. We'll call abort if alerts hit threshold.
Tess: final: release notes PR created and linked to release. Good job team. :tada:
